data.title: 青山七海 · 录音棚麦克风前的全力试音
data.description: 专业声优录音棚厚重的隔音室内，七海戴着监听耳机双手紧握台本站在专业悬挂麦克风前。她全情投入演绎台词，眼中泛着对梦想的滚烫泪光，神情坚毅动人。
data.location: professional voice recording booth with soundproof foam walls and suspended studio condenser microphone
data.action: standing before studio microphone wearing monitoring headphones, holding script with both hands, passionately delivering lines with glistening tearful amber eyes
data.lighting: 录音棚顶棚聚光射灯与指示灯幽光
data.promptProse: Nanami stands before a professional studio microphone wearing headphones, clutching her audition script as she pours her soul into the performance.
data.animaCaption: Studio spotlight reflects in her determined, glistening amber eyes as she speaks into the microphone.
